title: Avro duration converts three unsigned fixed-width fields without losing their units
summary: The logical Avro reader decoded the three independently written duration words in order. Both the logical and raw readers preserved the maximum unsigned millisecond value.

change.description: Java adds LogicalTypes.duration(), TimePeriod and DurationConversion for Avro’s 12-byte fixed duration logical type. Register the conversion on a GenericData instance when requesting logical values.

notes: The maximum unsigned 32-bit word is all ones, distinct from signed −1. A second reader without conversion exposes the physical field boundary.
